model.description: free text, same convention as benchmark.model

context_length.description: context size the measured_*_at_ctx figures were taken at; also named in methodology

kv_bytes_per_token.description: resident KV bytes per token at this configuration's dtype. For a measured record this is a model-geometry quantity, NOT a per-run memory reading: it equals the model's kv_cache_bytes_per_token scaled by dtype bytes / 2 (bf16 base). Derivation goes in kv_bytes_per_token_basis so a reader can re-run it with their own inputs. For an MLA model it is the latent-plus-rope size, NOT num_layers*num_kv_heads*head_dim*2*bytes - the same formula distinction model.kv_cache_bytes_per_token documents.

kv_bytes_per_token_basis.description: the derivation with numbers substituted, e.g. '80 layers x 8 kv heads x 128 head_dim x 2 tensors x 1 byte (fp8) = 163,840'. Same role as accelerator.flops[].basis_detail: a bytes figure with no derivation is a number nobody can check.

prefix_reuse.description: none = cold prefill, no shared-prefix cache in play. apc = vLLM-style hashed-block automatic prefix caching. radix = SGLang RadixAttention tree over token sequences. context-checkpoint = llama.cpp-style named KV snapshots. custom = anything else (LMCache, Strata n-gram, engine-specific). The prefix mechanism, not the eviction policy - H2O/SnapKV/StreamingLLM have no member and belong in quant_method or notes only when they change what is resident.

quant_method.description: the KV quantization method when kv_cache_dtype alone under-specifies it: e.g. 'kivi-asymmetric-2k4v', 'spinquant-w4a4kv4', 'gguf-q4_0-kv'. null when the dtype is a plain engine storage format (--kv-cache-dtype fp8) with no named method behind it.

measured_ttft_ms_at_ctx.description: TTFT in milliseconds measured at context_length, cold cache unless prefix_reuse says otherwise. null when the run published no TTFT - an absent number, never a zero.

measured_tps_at_ctx.description: tokens/s measured at context_length, per-request decode or single-stream prefill per methodology. null when the run published no throughput - an absent number, never a zero.

methodology.description: batch/concurrency, model + weight quant, KV config, context size, what the measured_* fields actually count. Same rule as benchmark.methodology: a number without its conditions is unquotable.

sources.description: source ids; each must exist in data/sources/
